title: Keating teaches by asking
body: Every step optional. Chat is one click away.
line: Keating 4.0 starts by getting to know you. Every step is optional, and chat is always one click away.

title: How should Keating teach you?
line: Tell it how much to ask before it tells, what to do when you're stuck, and where to draw its analogies from.

title: Requirements, not suggestions
line: Accessibility choices are treated as requirements: plain language, captions, easier typography, and reduced motion.

title: Goals that don't take over
body: Saved for later. Today's question still leads.
line: Longer goals are saved as pursuits. They stay close by, but today's question still leads.

title: Shape the teacher
body: Persona, speech and voice, all editable.
line: In Settings, you can reshape the teacher itself: its persona, its voice, and how it speaks.

title: A tour of your own screen
body: Replayable, and it skips what's closed.
line: Then choose Show me around first, and Keating points out the composer, the sessions, and the study panel, on the screen you're actually using.
